name: han-ddd
description: Strategic Domain-Driven Design analysis for the Han suite: domain boundary discovery, bounded context identification, and evidence-backed context mapping.

interface.shortDescription: Strategic Domain-Driven Design analysis and context mapping.
interface.longDescription: Analyzes an existing codebase using strategic Domain-Driven Design to discover domain boundaries, identify bounded contexts, find boundary leaks, and produce an evidence-backed domain and context map. Discovery and analysis only — does not recommend service splits or migration plans.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this repository's domain boundaries with /ddd-analysis.
Discover the bounded contexts in this codebase.
Produce a domain and context map for this project.
